description: This Java class 'AppListFragment' extends 'BaseActivityListFragment' and manages a list of launcher activities, handling UI interactions such as binding actions and launching activities, specifically for handling app shortcuts within the Android launcher environment.

classes.name: AppListFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that displays launchable activities and manages shortcut bindings in a launcher environment.

methods.name: getActivities
methods.description: Returns a list of launcher activities for a specified user.

methods.name: onBindAction2
methods.description: Binds an action to a button if the activity has shortcuts and the user is unlocked.

methods.name: onLaunch
methods.description: Starts the main activity for the specified launcher activity info.

methods.name: onAction2
methods.description: Creates and starts an intent to launch a specific shortcut activity.
